headline: 🔴 FastJson RCE Active Exploitation, 🔴 Arista/Fortinet CISA KEV Adds, 🎯 Dysphoria Botnet 200K Devices, 🎯 EY Breach Claimed by ShinyHunters, ⚠️ Certighost AD CS PoC, 📋 Wyden Urges Legacy VPN Purge
